items.name: Philip Morris International
items.headline: Updates 2026 adjusted EPS forecast for currency only after Q3 results
items.catalyst: Q3 net revenues were $11,438M versus $10,845M; adjusted diluted EPS was $2.36 versus $2.24 and the full-year adjusted EPS forecast is $8.29 to $8.44.
items.thesis: The release separates currency effects from operating changes, and it says organic operating income growth is now more likely in the middle or lower half of its 7% to 9% range. That wording is the part of the update to watch.
items.source_name: Philip Morris International Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K)

items.name: Snap-on
items.headline: Q3 sales dip and EPS falls against a year-ago legal settlement benefit
items.catalyst: Q3 net sales were $1,183.7M versus $1,190.8M and diluted EPS was $4.64 versus $5.02; the year-ago quarter included a $0.31 per-share legal settlement benefit.
items.thesis: Organic sales fell 2.8% and operating margin before financial services narrowed to 21.0% from 23.4%. Part of that gap reflects the prior-year benefit, which the release put at 190 basis points.

items.name: Allegion
items.headline: Q3 revenue and EPS rise; 2026 adjusted EPS outlook of $9.05 to $9.10
items.catalyst: Q3 revenue was $1,172.6M versus $1,070.2M and adjusted EPS was $2.60 versus $2.30.
items.thesis: Organic revenue grew 7.2% in the quarter, while the 2026 outlook calls for organic growth of 5.0% to 6.0%. The gap between the two is the comparison to watch when the company reports again.

items.name: Nasdaq
items.headline: Q3 solutions revenue and annualized recurring revenue rise
items.catalyst: Q3 net revenue was $1,481M versus $1,315M; non-GAAP diluted EPS was $1.04 versus $0.88 and annualized recurring revenue was $3,365M.
items.thesis: Solutions revenue grew 17% reported to $1,172M, and annualized recurring revenue was up 12% reported. The headline of the release features both figures.

items.name: Honeywell Technologies
items.headline: Raises 2026 adjusted EPS outlook after Q3 results
items.catalyst: Honeywell reported Q3 sales of $4,994M, up 1% reported and 7% organic, adjusted EPS of $2.27 versus $1.70, and raised its 2026 adjusted EPS outlook to $8.40-$8.45 from $8.05-$8.35.
items.thesis: The new range lifts the midpoint by about $0.23 per share. The gap between 1% reported and 7% organic growth shows portfolio changes are shaping the headline sales line.

items.name: Lockheed Martin
items.headline: Lifts 2026 EPS and free cash flow outlook after Q3
items.catalyst: Lockheed Martin reported Q3 sales of $20.7B, up 11% from $18.6B, diluted EPS of $7.97 versus $6.95, and raised 2026 diluted EPS to about $30.35-$30.75 and free cash flow to about $7.8-$8.0B.
items.thesis: The free cash flow range rose by roughly $0.8B at both ends, a larger step than the EPS raise. Cash conversion is the detail behind this update.

items.name: Union Pacific
items.headline: Q3 EPS rises as operating ratio improves on higher carloads
items.catalyst: Union Pacific reported Q3 diluted EPS of $3.49, up 16%, adjusted EPS of $3.53, up 15%, an operating ratio of 59.1% (58.8% adjusted) and revenue carloads up 6%.
items.thesis: Volume growth and margin improving together is the combination investors look for in a railroad. The next test is whether that holds as the company's other filings and regulatory events develop.
items.source_name: Union Pacific Q3 2026 earnings release (investor relations)

items.name: Texas Instruments
items.headline: Q3 results and a wide fourth-quarter guidance range
items.catalyst: Texas Instruments reported Q3 revenue of $6.06B and EPS of $2.62, and guided Q4 revenue to $5.80B-$6.30B and EPS to $2.45-$2.79.
items.thesis: A Q4 revenue range spanning $0.5B signals management sees a wide spread of outcomes for demand. The midpoint of $6.05B sits just below Q3 revenue.
